Scope: skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md, skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (the two `objectstack-query` CEILINGS rows), packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts (`NowAnchorSchema`, `AddDaysReferenceSchema`, the `$now` docblock), packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-type.ts (`isNowAnchor` / `isWellFormedNowAnchor` / `malformedNowAnchorRefusal`), packages/spec/src/data/filter-lowering.ts, packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-shape.ts, packages/core/src/utils/filter-tokens.ts (`resolveNowAnchor`, `MalformedNowAnchorError`), packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts (`nowAnchorOf`, `nowAnchorPositionError`, `NUMERIC_SCALAR_TYPES`), packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-cross-field-comparison.ts (`applyNowAnchorComparison`), packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-filter.ts, packages/formula/src/matches-filter.ts (`resolveNowAnchor`, `resolveDayOffset`), packages/objectql/src/engine-now-anchor.test.ts, packages/spec/src/data/filter.test.ts, packages/formula/src/matches-filter-now-anchor.test.ts, .github/workflows/lint.yml, .claude/agents/os-dev.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:313 (as landed in `b33dd25b`), issue #25808, the audit table on #26184 (comment 6425678185, row Q1), card #26301 and its four comments (6431849616, 6432006578, 6432051384, 6432431995).

Inputs read over REST (curl, bearer token from the environment, never printed): `issues/26301`, `issues/26301/comments`, `pulls/26407`, `pulls/26407/reviews`, `issues/26407/comments`, `issues/25808`, `commits/13e75c8c/check-runs`. Files read with `git show 13e75c8c:PATH` and `git show origin/main:PATH` after `git fetch`; the shared checkout was not switched.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Every new sentence against the spec on `origin/main`.** The new `rules/filters.md` section (L57–81 on the head) was checked clause by clause.
- "the instant the query runs at, shifted by whole days — legal exactly where a `{ $field }` reference is: the whole comparand of `$eq`/`$ne`/`$gt`/`$gte`/`$lt`/`$lte` on a `date` or `datetime` field. The engine pins `$now` to ONE instant per query" — RIGHT: `filter.zod.ts` `$now` docblock ("legal exactly where a `{ $field }` reference is — the whole comparand of the six scalar comparisons"; "ONE instant for the whole filter, pinned by the engine's placeholder resolver"; "applies to a `date` or `datetime` target only"); `filter.test.ts` L270 parses all six operators; `filter-tokens.ts` `resolveNowAnchor` writes the one pinned ISO instant (`engine-now-anchor.test.ts` L106–114 shows both the column and the literal arm pinned).
- The example `due_at: { $lt: { $now: true, addDays: { $field: 'grace_days_offset' } } }` with the column holding NEGATIVE days — RIGHT: it is the spec's own first `@example` (`review_sla_days_offset`, "the column holding the NEGATIVE number of SLA days") and the ruling's letter-A semantics on #25808 ("now minus the column" is a column that holds a negative number; `matches-filter-now-anchor.test.ts` L62 "a NEGATIVE offset; a column holds its sign"). The sign is not fixed: `addDays` is always added, so a stored negative value really moves backwards.
- "`addDays` is required and always ADDED: an integer of any sign (`-30` is thirty days ago keeping the time of day, where `{30_days_ago}` names a calendar day; for the bare instant write `{now}`)" — RIGHT: `NowAnchorSchema.addDays` is non-optional, `z.number().int()` or `AddDaysReferenceSchema`; the spec's second `@example` says exactly this (`-30` "with its time of day — unlike `{30_days_ago}`, which names the calendar DAY"); `filter-tokens.ts` L420 resolves `now` as an instant and L434 renders `N_days_ago` as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Precision note, not an error: "keeping the time of day" holds against a `datetime` target; against a `date` target the instant is read as its UTC calendar day (spec docblock "The target column decides the form") — the section's example target is a `datetime`, so the sentence is right where it is used.
- "or a `{ $field }` naming a **number** field of the same record (NULL counts as zero days)" — RIGHT on same-record and NULL (`AddDaysReferenceSchema` carries `$field` only; "A NULL offset column contributes ZERO days", `resolveDayOffset` returns 0 on null, SQL uses `COALESCE`). Precision note: the spec says NUMERIC column, and `driver-sql` accepts the whole numeric class (`NUMERIC_SCALAR_TYPES` = `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES` number, currency, percent, rating, slider, progress, summary + integer/int/float); teaching "number" is the safe subset, not a falsehood. The same word recurs in "SQL push-down also refuses a dotted or non-number offset field" — strictly "non-numeric"; a `currency` offset column compiles. Carried as to-do, below.
- "The filter cannot negate a positive `grace_days` column: store the signed offset" — RIGHT (spec: "so 'now minus the column' is a column that holds a negative number"; there is no subtraction form).
- "Refused with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400: an anchor without `addDays`, a fractional or string offset" — RIGHT at every door: `malformedNowAnchorRefusal` (`invalidComparandError`, code `INVALID_FILTER`, status 400), `MalformedNowAnchorError` in the resolver (same code), `engine-now-anchor.test.ts` L117–129 and L187–192.
- "any extra key (there is no `subDays`)" — RIGHT of the spec's declaration: `NowAnchorSchema` is `closedObject(...).strict()` and `filter.test.ts` L263–265 pins "an extra key is refused — there is no subDays". Enforcement gap I read, not a skill error: `parseFilterAST` runs lowering plus the comparand-type door, whose `isWellFormedNowAnchor` tests only `addDays`; the resolver spreads `...node`; `driver-sql` reads the anchor by shape; the memory evaluator pins "an extra key does not disqualify it" (`matches-filter-now-anchor.test.ts` L167). So on a direct `engine.find()` `where` an extra key is tolerated and ignored, while the declaration door (metadata filters, `aggregate()` whose options are zod-parsed — `engine-now-anchor.test.ts` L187 "refused by its declaration") refuses it. The sentence is true of the spec as declared; the gap is the engine's, filed below as a card candidate.
- "a target that is not `date` / `datetime`" — RIGHT: spec docblock "on a number, a text or a `time`, day arithmetic has no meaning and the comparison is refused loudly"; `applyNowAnchorComparison` L497–507 and `having-filter.ts` L711 refuse with `INVALID_FILTER` (`engine-now-anchor.test.ts` L175). Note: the in-memory evaluator alone (`matchesFilter`, no column declaration) fails closed rather than loudly; the spec's own words are "refused loudly", which the skill repeats.
- "and any `$in` / `$nin` / `$between` position" — RIGHT: `SetOperatorSchema` / `RangeOperatorSchema` refuse it (`filter.test.ts` L276–278), `driver-sql` `nowAnchorPositionError` refuses a list member (`INVALID_FILTER`), `engine-now-anchor.test.ts` L195–200. Same pattern as the file's existing Field References claim for `$field`.
- "SQL push-down also refuses a dotted or non-number offset field" — RIGHT on dotted (`applyNowAnchorComparison` L515–519) and on non-numeric (L528–534, `engine-now-anchor.test.ts` L179 "a TEXT offset column is refused"); it also refuses an undeclared offset column and the tenant column, which the section does not list (an omission inside "refuses", not a false clause). A nullable offset column is NOT refused — NULL is zero days — and the section says so.
- "The filter alone answers it — not a stored formula field plus a hook" — the card's "who pays"; RIGHT.
- Not stated, worth knowing: `driver-mongodb` refuses the anchor outright (`mongodb-filter.ts` L299, `nowAnchorUnsupportedError`), exactly as it refuses `{ $field }`; the file's Field References section is equally silent on Mongo, so the new section inherits that silence rather than adding a falsehood.
- `SKILL.md` pointer (L198–200): "`{ $now: true, addDays: OFFSET }` is the instant the query runs at, shifted by whole days a number field of the record holds" — true for the column arm; it omits the integer-literal arm, which the rules file teaches. A pointer, not a rule; precision to-do.

**(b) Cuts.** Nothing is deleted anywhere in the diff (`skills/**` hunks are pure additions; the ratchet hunks replace two rows). The dev's "nothing duplicated to cut" claim was judged by reading the whole head `filters.md` (211 lines): the new clauses do not restate the Date Macros section (which lists `{now}` and `{30_days_ago}` as tokens but never their instant-vs-calendar-day reading) nor the Common Mistakes. One near-restatement inside the new section itself: "legal exactly where a `{ $field }` reference is" plus Field References L53–55 already imply the list-position refusal that "any `$in` / `$nin` / `$between` position" then spells out — about a dozen tokens, explicit on purpose for the refusal list; not a genuine duplicate under ruling A.

**(c) Ratchet rows.** Measured with the script's own convention, `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`, over `git show 13e75c8c:PATH` (`wc -c`; the SKILL.md stamp line `  version: "18.1.0"` plus newline, 20 bytes, excluded as the script's ONE exclusion): `rules/filters.md` 9928 bytes → 2482 = the new row 2482 (before: 8589 → 2148 under the old 2149, so +334 landed, 1 absorbed, ceiling +333 — the row comment's arithmetic is right); `evals/filters-pagination-search.json` 4699 bytes → 1175 = the new row 1175 (before 3819 → 955, headroom 0, +220); `SKILL.md` 16691 − 20 = 16671 → 4168 under the untouched 5547 (before 4124). Both raised rows are pinned at zero headroom; no headroom smuggled in. The ruling (tap A, 2026-10-27T01:21Z, 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」) is quoted verbatim in both row comments and in the PR body, which is where the script's header requires it ("a PR whose body quotes a maintainer ruling"). No other commit between the merge-base `a66c9ff4` and `origin/main` touches the ratchet script or `skills/objectstack-query/**`. Gate verdicts on the head: `Type Check · source gates` (carries `check-skills-token-ratchet` + `--self-test`, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs` per `lint.yml` L5358/L5490/L5621) success at 2026-10-27T02:46Z; `Lint · repo & tooling gates` success; `Lint · ESLint` success (no `max-len` rule found in the ESLint config, and the long row-comment lines pass).

**(d) Evals.** Case 6 appended; ids 1–6 unique and sequential; the file parses as JSON; every `must_contain` string (`$now: true`, `addDays`, `$field: 'grace_days_offset'`, `$lt`) occurs in `expected_output`, neither `must_not_contain` string (`subDays`, `type: 'formula'`) does — checked by reading, consistent with the dev's claim. The prompt states the schema (`due_at` datetime, `grace_days_offset` number holding negative days), so the expected spelling is determinate. The one eval the card asks for is present; no eval README or SKILL.md prompt count exists to update. `Type Check · consumer gates` (`check:skill-examples`, `lint.yml` L6495) success at 2026-10-27T02:46Z; the new fence is an unmarked `where:` fragment like the file's other fragments.

**(e) Wanted lines met, nothing beyond.** The card wants "one subsection in `rules/filters.md` between Field References and Date Filtering Patterns, with the one example, and where the comparand is accepted and refused": one subsection, placed directly under Field References (L57, inside the named span), one example, acceptance and refusal lists — met. The dev's reason for the placement (the anchor is legal exactly where a `{ $field }` reference is and borrows its `addDays` grammar) is true of the spec. `SKILL.md` line 1 (`---`) and the version stamp are untouched (hunks at L86 and L195 only); the two pointer lines are inside the claim's file surface (`skills/objectstack-query/**`) though the order said "untouched unless you must" — declared as a deviation, inside headroom, no raise. No file outside the claim's surface.

**(f) PR body.** Lines 1–2 are the harness attribution comment and the `_Requested by_` line; `Fixes #26301` on line 3 — exactly the exemption os-dev.md L323 writes ("harness 自写的 PR 正文首行归属注释原样留、只报;`Fixes` 紧随其后"), and `Part-of PR must not also close its card` / `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` are green on the head. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial. `Skills-docs: updated here` is not owed (kind `none`, no `(narrowing)` arm) but a written line must be true: under pm-dispatch SKILL.md:313 as landed in `b33dd25b`, `updated here` = "this diff teaches it in `skills/**` ... and the package's evals exercise it" — this diff does both (the section and eval 6), so the line is TRUE. `## 维护者速读` carries the six labels in order; 需要你做的 names approve / Merge when ready for Tier H; 两分钟验证 names the ratchet command and the exact lines it prints (`is 2482 tokens (ceiling 2482; headroom 0)`), which is the script's report shape. The two readings (per-file and whole-package before/after lines and tokens: 185→211, 401→403, 55→65, package 1063→1091 lines, 9660→10038 tokens) are present; the line counts match `wc -l` on both trees.

**(g) Report and claim.** os-dev-report 6432431995 (2026-10-27T02:42Z) carries every key of the os-dev.md L360–382 template plus `deviations` (6), `line_budget`, `out_of_scope_findings` (1); `files_changed` / `rules_retired` are not in the template on `origin/main` and are not present — no gap. Branch `claude/project-thread-r9vctw` = the claim's `Branch:` line; `mcp_calls: 2` (reads), `api_writes: 2`. The relay wrote assignee `os-warren` and label `skip-changeset` at `pr_create`.

**Check-runs on `13e75c8c`** read at 2026-10-27T02:51Z: 46 runs, 45 completed, 0 failed, 1 in progress (`Test Core (1/8)`). Green: both Governed Surface Queue Guard runs, Part-of guard, claim guards, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Build Core, Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · workspace, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards.
